description: Source file implementing the 'phy_to_fapi_results_event_fastpath_translator' class, which translates PHY layer results into FAPI indications for 5G NR protocols, including PRACH, PUSCH, PUCCH, SRS, and RACH indications.

classes.name: p7_indications_notifier_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of 'fapi::p7_indications_notifier' that provides empty overrides for indication callbacks.

methods.name: phy_to_fapi_results_event_fastpath_translator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the translator with sector ID, calibration value, and logger.

methods.name: convert_to_dBFS
methods.description: Converts normalized dB values to dBFS using a full-scale reference.

methods.name: on_new_prach_results
methods.description: Handles new PRACH results, generating RACH indications if preambles are valid.

methods.name: on_new_pusch_results_control
methods.description: Handles new PUSCH control results, triggering UCI indication notifications.

methods.name: on_new_pusch_results_data
methods.description: Handles new PUSCH data results, triggering CRC and RX data indications.

methods.name: notify_pusch_uci_indication
methods.description: Constructs and sends UCI indications for PUSCH results.

methods.name: notify_crc_indication
methods.description: Constructs and sends CRC indications for PUSCH results.

methods.name: notify_rx_data_indication
methods.description: Constructs and sends RX data indications for PUSCH results.

methods.name: fill_format_0_1_sr
methods.description: Fills SR parameters for PUCCH Format 0/1.

methods.name: fill_format_0_1_harq
methods.description: Fills HARQ parameters for PUCCH Format 0/1.

methods.name: add_format_0_1_pucch_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PUCCH Format 0/1 PDU to the indication builder.

methods.name: fill_format_2_3_4_harq
methods.description: Fills HARQ parameters for PUCCH Format 2/3/4.

methods.name: fill_format_2_3_4_sr
methods.description: Fills SR parameters for PUCCH Format 2/3/4.

methods.name: fill_format_2_3_4_csi_part1
methods.description: Fills CSI Part 1 parameters for PUCCH Format 2/3/4.

methods.name: add_format_2_3_4_pucch_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PUCCH Format 2/3/4 PDU to the indication builder.

methods.name: on_new_srs_results
methods.description: Handles new SRS results, generating SRS indications.
